scientific_integrity: A bilateral, synchronous, two-update image-language theorem with a reproducible exact finite-state proof. The checker certifies the claimed all-length recurrence, automaton equivalence, characteristic polynomial, and spectral bounds. Independent expert review not performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the second spatial image, not third or limiting images, indexed cyclic rings, or asynchronous/staggered cellular automata.
An earlier finite-time process-graph article is available in abstract but not complete text; historical priority remains provisional.
The topological entropy is that of the spatial shift on the image, not the time action of F itself.
title: Exact second-image word growth and entropy of synchronous Rule 54
